summary.plain: PandaX-II was the second stage of the Chinese PandaX programme: a half-tonne liquid xenon detector in the Jinping underground laboratory, running from 2016 to 2019. It saw no dark matter and, in 2016-2017, set the strongest limits then published.
summary.technical: Dual-phase xenon TPC with a 500 kg liquid xenon target at CJPL. Commissioning run 21 Nov - 14 Dec 2015; physics Runs 9, 10, 11 (March 2016 - August 2018, 132 ton day total); official shutdown 29 June 2019. Full-exposure spin-independent limit 2.2e-46 cm^2 at 30 GeV/c^2. Successor of PandaX-I; superseded by PandaX-4T.

technology.quote: We report the WIMP dark matter search results using the first physics-run data of the PandaX-II 500 kg liquid xenon dual-phase time-projection chamber, operating at the China JinPing Underground Laboratory.
